claims: Compact independent-replication experiment; no large-profile or universal-improvement claim.

notes: This is a compact resource-limited study, not the full 25x25 30-replication preregistered profile.
All candidates share conditioning preprocessing, geometry, fitting endpoint, validation and final blocks.
The short model has the same causal history but a shorter recent likelihood window.
Independent simulation replications are the bootstrap unit; forecast origins are averaged within replication.
No guarantees of improved prediction are assumed.
The finite RHS slab c=64 is calibrated on an independent development pilot; the failed random-slab pilot remains archived.
Ridge short and long passed the 1500-draw development gate; their predeclared final maximum is 3000, with unchanged convergence thresholds and explicit failure reporting.
The final runtime ceiling was amended from 12 to 15 minutes before any final-stage data generation.
Both random-slab and fixed-slab RHS pilots failed the diagnostic gate; the fourth primary candidate is grouped Gaussian M1, with unchanged data and expressive features.
